//: The import rules between the parts of the repository (REFACTOR-PLAN.md section 2.2, PKG-0). scripts/check/boundaries.mjs (npm run check:boundaries) reads every static import, re-export and literal dynamic import() in the tracked .js/.mjs/.cjs files and fails on an edge the importing unit does not allow. A file belongs to the first unit whose paths hold it, so the narrower units come first. `allow` lists the units a unit may import (itself always; '*' any, '!name' not that one); `node` says whether node:* built-ins are allowed; npm packages (bare names) and imports of files no unit holds (data, root files) are not checked. Departures from the plan's table, by decision: core and api may import the generated registry slices (registries-browser, pure data; api for the contribution machine decide.js reads); the exception that let map import frontend (src/) ended when rf9-mapapp (F2/F4, 12 Nov 2026) moved the rest of the map app into packages/map/src/. api may import ui (rf9-ui, 12 Nov 2026, survey item 1b): the PRONI record page's server render writes the record with the app's own renderer, packages/ui/src/templates/proni/record-view.js; ui never imports api. The served pages (site/, site/apps/ as its own unit, and the retired apps' kill-switch worker render/sw.js) are not bundled, so a relative import of packages/ would 404: they import only site/ files, and package code reaches them through the served shims (site-served: site/assets/ui/, re-exports of what packages/served.json serves there); site/ may not import an app under site/apps/ (added 11 Nov 2026, architecture rule R1, after the site move had left site/ in no unit). `baseline` lists known violating edges ('from -> to' file paths); it may only shrink. It is empty: its one entry, the PRONI record page's server render importing the PRONI app's renderer, went when rf9-ui moved the renderer into packages/ui (12 Nov 2026), where both now import it. `unowned` lists the scripts deliberately in no unit, with reasons.

api.//: ui since 12 Nov 2026 (rf9-ui): the PRONI record page's server render (handlers/proni/page.js) writes the record with the browser app's own renderer, packages/ui/src/templates/proni/record-view.js, a pure string module.

site-pkg.//: site/pkg/: one re-export per package module a served page imports from /pkg/ (packages/served.json), so Node and tsc resolve the page's import to the package. Pure browser packages only. Every served page may import them (site, site-apps, elections-app): Browse and Words in parliament read the origins from /pkg/config/src/config.js (architecture rule R6, check C5).

elections-app.//: The Elections app (site/apps/elections/, served unbundled at /apps/elections/): its own modules, the served package modules under /pkg/ (site-pkg), and the served shims under /assets/ui/ (site-served: /assets/ui/state/machine.js). Never packages/ by a relative path: a served page cannot reach it.

site-served.//: The shims under site/ at a path packages/served.json serves from a package (site/assets/ui/ is packages/ui/assets/): each only re-exports the package file, so Node and tsc resolve a page's import to the module the browser is given. The only site/ files that may import packages/.

site-apps.//: site-pkg since 12 Nov 2026 (rf8-frontend, R10): Words in parliament formats its numbers with the shared formatter, /pkg/core/src/format.js, as the Elections app does.

site.//: Served pages (Browse and the other unbundled pages): their own site/ modules, the served shims under /assets/ui/ (site-served) and the served package modules under /pkg/ (site-pkg, packages/served.json; Browse imports core's escaping, slug and no-poll rules there since 12 Nov 2026, stream rf8-types, and writes its numbers and month names with the shared formatter, /pkg/core/src/format.js and date-format.mjs, stream rf8-frontend, R10).

frontend.//: src/ holds only vendored third-party browser files since rf9-mapapp (12 Nov 2026) moved the map app's modules into packages/map/src/ (still served at their /src/ paths, packages/served.json): src/libs/ (the Elections app's self-hosted libraries, scripts/build/elections-app/vendor.mjs) and src/sql.js-httpvfs/. They import nothing outside src/.

engines.//: The engine rule (architecture rule R1, REFACTOR-PLAN.md ST-7, stream rf9-loader-storage, 12 Nov 2026): only the units in `units` may use an engine API, a module in `modules` (an entry ending in / covers the modules under it), by an import, an import() or a JSDoc type import(). Everything else opens a database or a bucket through packages/storage (openSqliteHandle and openSqlite for SQLite files, fsBlobStore for folders; the Functions reach D1, R2 and KV through fromD1 and blobStore, held by tests/functions/blob-store.test.mjs and named-queries.test.mjs), so a database swap touches only the adapter (acceptance test A3). `tests` may use the engine too: a fixture builds a database with it, and a test that reads a file without the adapter is an independent check of the adapter. `baseline` lists the known uses ('file -> module') and only shrinks: the publish scripts reach R2 through the S3 client directly, as packages/storage has no S3 blob store yet (plan ST-2's s3.mjs).

unowned.//: Tracked scripts that belong to no unit, each with its reason (architecture rule R1; check C2 in npm run check:architecture fails on a script in no unit and not listed here, and on an entry here that matches nothing). A key ending in / covers a folder.
unowned.eslint.config.mjs: the linter's own configuration, read only by eslint
unowned.config/playwright.config.cjs: the browser-test runner's configuration, read only by Playwright
unowned.data/elections-source/js/: the election viewer's source copy (classic scripts, no imports); check:viewer-parity holds site/app/election-viewer-package/ to it
unowned.data/review-inputs/: one-off review tools kept with the review inputs they read; never imported or served
unowned.docs/: example and handoff scripts quoted by documents; never imported, served or run by the build
